description: E001 remains a search-snippet lead. Whether an in-person Buraidah demonstration occurred as a public meeting is unresolved; no source body was reviewed.

description: Publication dates in early February do not establish E001’s physical event date, precise date, end or February ownership; no dated onset or event boundary is verified.

description: Some E001 snippets say “hundreds,” but the source body, attendance basis and upstream origin are unknown; the required threshold of at least 50 is not verified.
required_followup: Find an accessible report with a sourced crowd estimate or direct threshold evidence; do not treat the repeated “hundreds” snippet as a verified lower bound.

description: E001 snippets allege economic hardship, unemployment, tax and quarantine grievances, but exact demands, organizers, recipients and direction toward the Saudi state remain unknown.

description: Al Alam and Together for Justice accounts overlap, and some results quote social-media material or repeat a Qassim police account. Together for Justice, Al Alam, IslamTimes and Al-Ahed are not assumed independent confirmations. Watanserb and its archive appear derivative.

description: Protester violence and all seven state-response values remain unknown for both leads. Unverified snippets allege arrests, dispersal orders, force or clashes, but do not establish event/date scope.

description: Twelve open-web searches covered Arabic and English broad and weekly windows, named Buraidah/Qassim and other sources, and a February–March continuity check; they are not systematic coverage of local/regional press archives, dialect/local-language sources, databases or social platforms and do not establish absence or exhaustiveness.

description: S001 Al Alam stayed search_only because its source-specific access chain mechanically aborted before any body request was dispatched. There was no HTTP denial or observed Saudi URL access restriction; do not classify it as blocked or inaccessible.
required_followup: The body remains essential for occurrence, exact date, turnout, demand, source attribution and response verification. Reassess only in a separately authorized open phase using a fresh exact-URL receipt/manual review/current-input guard; this mechanical abort is not a denial.
